items.ex: I'll fry a couple of eggs for brekkie.
items.tip: brekkie = breakfast（澳洲口语）；deep-fry = 油炸

items.ex: Can you chop the onions while I start the sauce?
items.tip: 切丁是 dice，切片是 slice

items.ex: Pass the salt shaker, please.
items.tip: 撒一点盐 = sprinkle some salt

items.ex: Mum's beef stew is perfect for a cold night.
items.tip: 澳洲人也常说 casserole

items.ex: Let's get dumplings in Chinatown tonight.
items.tip: 小笼包是 soup dumplings / xiao long bao

items.ex: Can I get a water with a few ice cubes?
items.tip: no ice = 去冰

items.ex: I just had a bowl of cereal for breakfast.
items.tip: 和 serial（连续的）同音

items.ex: A croissant and a flat white, please.
items.tip: 澳洲人常读 /krəˈsɒnt/，两种都能听懂

items.ex: The cutlery is in the top drawer.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 cutlery，美国说 silverware

items.ex: Do you want a soft drink with your meal?
items.tip: 澳洲说 soft drink，美国说 soda；fizzy drink 也行

items.ex: I packed a popper in the kids' lunchboxes.
items.tip: 澳洲特有说法，别的地方叫 juice box

items.ex: Nothing beats a meat pie at the footy.
items.tip: pie with sauce = 配番茄酱的肉派

items.ex: Wear your runners, we're walking to the beach.
items.tip: 澳洲说 runners，美国说 sneakers，英国说 trainers

items.ex: Don't forget your swimmers and a towel!
items.tip: 澳洲也说 cossie / togs，美国说 swimsuit

items.ex: He turned up to the barbie in boardies and thongs.
items.tip: board shorts 的澳洲简称

items.zh: 荧光背心、高可见度工作服
items.ex: All visitors must wear hi-vis on site.
items.tip: high-visibility 的简称，澳洲工地必备

items.ex: Bring hiking boots for the Blue Mountains walk.
items.tip: 澳洲人也常说 go bushwalking（去丛林徒步）

items.ex: It's cold in Melbourne — pack a scarf.
items.tip: 复数 scarves

items.ex: I lost one of my gloves on the tram.
items.tip: 注意发音 /ɡlʌvz/，o 读 ʌ

items.ex: I always carry flats in my bag for the walk home.
items.tip: flat 在澳洲还指「公寓」

items.ex: My feet are killing me — never wearing heels to a wedding again.
items.tip: high heels 的简称；my feet are killing me = 脚疼死了

items.ex: I can't read the menu without my glasses.
items.tip: 口语也说 specs；墨镜是 sunnies

items.ex: She showed everyone her engagement ring at work.
items.tip: 结婚戒指是 wedding ring

items.ex: Tie the gift with a pink ribbon.
items.tip: 「蝴蝶结」也可以说 bow /bəʊ/

items.tip: 澳洲大蜥蜴叫 goanna；sunbake = 晒太阳（澳洲说法）

items.tip: crocodile 的口语简称；北领地常见警示牌 Beware of crocs

items.tip: 澳洲常见的大蝙蝠叫 flying fox（狐蝠）

items.ex: I saw a cockroach in the kitchen — call pest control!
items.tip: 口语说 roach；pest control = 灭虫公司

There's a big black beetle on the window.
items.tip: 大众甲壳虫汽车也叫 Beetle

items.ex: A ladybird landed on my arm.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 ladybird，美国说 ladybug

items.ex: The kids were catching grasshoppers in the paddock.
items.tip: paddock = 围起来的田地、牧场（澳洲常用）

items.ex: The caterpillars have eaten all my basil.
items.tip: 会变成 butterfly（蝴蝶）或 moth（飞蛾）

items.ex: The cockatoos wake me up screeching every morning.
items.tip: 澳洲到处是 cockatoo 和 galah（粉红凤头鹦鹉）；一般鹦鹉是 parrot

items.ex: You can watch little penguins come ashore at Phillip Island.
items.tip: Phillip Island 的 little penguins 是墨尔本周边热门景点

items.tip: 澳洲的天鹅是黑色的 black swan；「黑天鹅事件」也是金融常用词

items.tip: 澳洲人常说 I've got a temperature 表示发烧，也可以说 fever

items.ex: This meeting is giving me a headache.
items.tip: 也可以比喻「让人头疼的事」

items.ex: I can't smell anything — I've got a blocked nose.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 blocked nose，美国说 stuffy nose

items.tip: -ache 结尾：toothache 牙疼、stomachache 胃疼

items.ex: The x-ray showed a hairline fracture in her wrist.
items.tip: hairline fracture = 细微骨裂；口语说 broken bone

items.ex: He's been hitting the gym — look at those biceps!
items.tip: 单复数同形；口语也说 guns

items.ex: Bushfire smoke is bad for your lungs.
items.tip: 单数 lung

items.ex: Two glasses of wine and I'm already tipsy.
items.tip: 喝醉是 drunk；澳洲口语还说 pissed（醉了，不是生气）

items.ex: The kids threw up after the theme park ride.
items.tip: 正式说 vomit；澳洲口语也说 chuck

items.ex: Grandpa wears a hearing aid in his left ear.
I'm getting a manicure before the wedding.
items.tip: 澳洲口语说 get my nails done；足部护理是 pedicure

items.ex: Just a trim, please — only a couple of centimetres.
items.tip: 理发店常用：Just a trim, please；剪大改动是 haircut

items.ex: Can I grab a large flat white with oat milk?
items.tip: 澳洲咖啡店最常点的；Can I grab... 是点单常用说法

items.ex: There's a new bubble tea shop opening near work.
items.tip: 也叫 boba；少糖 = less sugar / 50% sugar

items.ex: She's switched from coffee to matcha lattes.

items.zh: 牛油果吐司（澳洲早午餐招牌）
items.ex: Smashed avo on sourdough is a classic Aussie brunch.
items.tip: avo = avocado；sourdough = 酸面包

items.ex: Grab a biscuit with your cuppa.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 biscuit（口语 bikkie），美国说 cookie；cuppa = 一杯茶

items.ex: They do amazing jam doughnuts at the market.
items.tip: 美国拼 donut

items.ex: We brought cupcakes for her birthday at work.
Let's do pancakes for brunch on Sunday.
items.tip: 澳洲小块的厚松饼叫 pikelets

items.ex: I'll have the waffle with berries and ice cream.
items.tip: waffle on 也指「啰嗦、说个不停」

items.ex: A toasted bagel with cream cheese, please.
items.tip: 注意读音 /ˈbeɪɡl/

items.ex: Let me put the kettle on and fill the teapot.
items.tip: put the kettle on = 烧水泡茶（很常用）

items.ex: Two teaspoons of sugar, please.
items.tip: 菜谱缩写 tsp；tablespoon（汤匙）缩写 tbsp

items.ex: Sorry, you're on mute — we can't hear you.
items.tip: 线上会议高频句：You're on mute! / Can you unmute?

items.ex: Could everyone turn their camera on for the intro?
items.tip: turn your camera on/off；关掉也可以说 go off camera

items.ex: I work from home on Mondays and Fridays.
items.tip: 缩写 WFH；hybrid = 混合办公

items.ex: Sorry, the reception's terrible in this lift.
items.tip: 澳洲人说 reception / signal；lift = 电梯

items.ex: My phone's fully charged, so we're good for the trip.
items.tip: 没电是 flat；充电 = charge

items.ex: Let's take a selfie in front of the Opera House.
items.tip: 自拍杆 selfie stick

items.ex: Don't forget to save the file before you close it.
items.tip: 这个软盘图标就是「保存」按钮

items.ex: Just bin that draft and start again.
items.tip: 澳洲口语 bin 也可以当动词「扔掉」；美国说 trash

items.ex: My inbox is out of control after the long weekend.
items.tip: inbox zero = 清空收件箱

items.ex: Let's sync tomorrow about the campaign.
items.tip: 职场口语：Let's sync / quick sync = 简单对一下

items.ex: Phones off during the presentation, please.
items.tip: 调静音是 put your phone on silent

items.ex: I can't work in an open office without noise-cancelling headphones.
items.tip: 入耳式的叫 earbuds；澳洲拼 cancelling（两个 l）

items.ex: Grab a brolly, it's meant to bucket down later.
items.tip: umbrella 的澳洲叫法；bucket down = 下倾盆大雨

items.ex: We pitched our tent right next to the river.
items.tip: 搭帐篷用动词 pitch，不说 build

items.ex: Book a campsite early — they fill up over Easter.
Dad's gone fishing off the jetty.
items.tip: 澳洲口语也说 throw a line in；jetty = 栈桥

items.ex: We hired kayaks and paddled around the bay.
items.tip: paddle = 划桨；canoe 是另一种独木舟

items.ex: The snorkelling on the Great Barrier Reef is unreal.
items.tip: 澳洲拼两个 l；unreal = 太棒了（澳洲口语）

items.ex: We roasted marshmallows over the campfire.
items.tip: 澳洲夏天常有 total fire ban（全面禁火）

items.ex: Royal National Park is only an hour from Sydney.
items.tip: 澳洲人常去国家公园 bushwalk（徒步）

items.ex: Throw the lifebuoy — someone's in trouble!
items.tip: 海滩救生员叫 lifesaver / lifeguard

items.ex: I do laps at the local pool before work.
items.tip: lap = 一个来回；澳洲人把游泳馆叫 the pool / aquatic centre

items.ex: The kids collected seashells along the beach.
items.tip: 绕口令：She sells seashells by the seashore

items.zh: 日落/日出前后的黄金光线时刻
items.ex: Let's do the photo shoot at golden hour.
items.tip: 拍照常用词；也可以直接说 sunset / sunrise

items.ex: Your employer pays 12% into your super.
items.tip: 澳洲人都简称 super；换工作记得合并 super 账户

items.ex: We got our full bond back when we moved out.
items.tip: 澳洲租房押金叫 bond，美国叫 security deposit

items.ex: Rate hikes have pushed up our mortgage repayments.
items.tip: t 不发音！读 /ˈmɔːɡɪdʒ/；也叫 home loan

items.ex: Our power bill doubled over winter.
items.tip: 澳洲口语说 power bill / electricity bill

items.ex: I'll send the invoice through by end of day.
items.tip: 职场常用：send through an invoice；EOD = end of day

items.ex: I splurged on new headphones after payday.
items.tip: payday = 发工资那天

items.ex: His parents are loaded — they've got a house in Byron.
items.tip: 口语形容人有钱；也可以说 rolling in it

items.ex: I'll do a bank transfer — what's your BSB?
items.tip: 澳洲转账要 BSB 和 account number；也常用 PayID

items.ex: Is there an ATM nearby? I need some cash.
items.tip: 也叫 cash machine；取钱 = withdraw cash

items.ex: Sorry, we're card only — no cash.
items.tip: card only = 只收刷卡；cash only = 只收现金

items.ex: We're cutting back on takeaway to save for a holiday.
items.tip: cut back on sth = 减少……的开销

items.ex: My niece keeps her pocket money in a piggy bank.
items.tip: pocket money = 零花钱

items.ex: You cooked, so I'll do the dishes.
items.tip: 澳洲也常说 do the washing-up

items.ex: I always make the bed before I leave for work.
items.tip: 铺床用动词 make，不是 do

items.ex: Can you fold the washing while I cook?
items.tip: 澳洲人把洗好的衣服叫 the washing；hang out the washing = 晾衣服

items.ex: The dryer always eats one sock — now I've got a drawer of odd socks.
items.tip: odd 在这里是「不成对的」，不是「奇怪」

items.ex: Put the bottles in the recycling — the yellow-lid bin.
items.tip: 澳洲黄盖桶是可回收，红盖是一般垃圾，绿盖是园林垃圾

items.ex: Could you water the plants while I'm away?
items.tip: pot plant = 盆栽（澳洲说法）

items.ex: I spent all Sunday scrubbing the shower.
items.tip: 比 wipe（轻轻擦）更用力

items.ex: There were suds everywhere after he put too much detergent in.
items.tip: detergent = 洗涤剂

items.ex: The toilet's blocked — where's the plunger?
items.tip: blocked toilet = 马桶堵了

items.ex: Back in a sec, just ducking to the loo.
items.tip: 澳洲口语也说 the toilet / dunny（老派）

items.ex: I'll run a bath and have an early night.
items.tip: early night = 早点睡

items.ex: We spent the whole weekend on the couch watching Netflix.
items.tip: 澳洲/美国多说 couch，英国常说 sofa；couch potato = 沙发土豆

items.ex: My son plays soccer every Saturday morning.
items.tip: 澳洲人说 football/footy 多指橄榄球，足球一般叫 soccer

items.ex: The whole office takes the day off for the grand final.
items.tip: 澳洲联赛的决赛叫 grand final，AFL 总决赛前一天维州放公假

items.ex: We're going to the races for the Melbourne Cup.
items.tip: Melbourne Cup = 「让全国停下来的比赛」，维州放假

items.ex: I try to hit the gym three times a week.
items.tip: lift weights = 举铁

items.ex: I'll go for a run before it gets too hot.
We went for a ride along the bay trail.
items.tip: 澳洲人说骑车常用 ride；cycling 也行

items.ex: He got a hole in one at the company golf day!
There's a table tennis table in the office break room.
items.tip: 口语也说 ping pong

items.ex: She does a boxing class before work.
items.tip: Boxing Day（12 月 26 日）跟拳击无关

items.ex: Let's do tenpin bowling for the team outing.
items.tip: 澳洲说 tenpin bowling；lawn bowls 是草地滚球

items.ex: Bouldering gyms are popping up everywhere in Sydney.
items.tip: 不用绳子的矮墙攀岩；rock climbing 是攀岩

items.ex: She won a gold medal in the pool at the Olympics.
items.tip: 银牌 silver，铜牌 bronze；口语 take gold = 夺冠

items.ex: The kids want to carve a pumpkin for Halloween.
items.tip: 南瓜灯叫 jack-o'-lantern；carve = 雕刻

items.ex: More Aussie kids go trick or treating every year.
items.tip: 10 月 31 日万圣节，在澳洲越来越流行

items.ex: Grab a bag of lollies for the trick-or-treaters.
items.tip: 澳洲说 lollies，美国说 candy，英国说 sweets

items.ex: Make a wish and blow out the candles!
items.tip: make a wish = 许愿

items.ex: I'd like to make a toast to the happy couple.
items.tip: toast 也是「吐司面包」；干杯直接说 Cheers!

items.ex: Let's crack open the bubbly — we hit our target!
items.tip: crack open = 开（一瓶酒）

items.ex: Can you help me wrap a present for Mum?
items.tip: wrapping paper = 包装纸；w 不发音

items.ex: Sydney's New Year's Eve fireworks are world-famous.
What are you doing for Chrissy this year?
items.tip: Christmas 的澳洲简称；Chrissy pressie = 圣诞礼物

items.ex: The kids took turns whacking the piñata.
items.tip: whack = 用力打

items.ex: We ended the work party with karaoke.
items.tip: 英文读音和中文差很多：/ˌkæriˈəʊki/

items.ex: There was a giant disco ball above the dance floor.
items.tip: 也叫 mirror ball

items.ex: Just tick the box if you agree.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 tick，美国说 check mark

items.ex: Can someone take the minutes for today's meeting?
items.tip: take the minutes = 做会议记录；注意和「分钟」同形

items.ex: A bar chart would make this data much easier to read.
items.tip: 饼图 pie chart，折线图 line graph

items.ex: The deadline for the proposal is COB Friday.
items.tip: COB = close of business（下班前）

items.ex: We smashed our sales target this quarter.
items.tip: smash a target = 大幅超额完成

items.ex: Let's brainstorm some ideas for the campaign.
items.tip: idea 也可以说 have a lightbulb moment

items.ex: There's a big announcement at the all-hands meeting.
items.tip: all-hands = 全员大会

items.ex: Just a friendly reminder that timesheets are due today.
items.tip: Just a friendly reminder… 是职场邮件超常用开头

items.ex: I have to go into head office in the CBD on Tuesdays.
items.tip: CBD = 市中心商业区（澳洲常用）

items.ex: We hot desk now, so get in early to grab a spot.
items.tip: hot desking = 不设固定座位的办公方式

items.ex: I'm on annual leave next week — back on the 10th.
items.tip: 澳洲说 annual leave，美国说 vacation；请假 = take leave

items.ex: He chucked a sickie the day after the grand final.
items.tip: chuck a sickie = 澳洲俚语「请病假（常暗示装病）」

items.ex: Bunnings has tomato seedlings on special this week.
items.tip: Bunnings = 澳洲最大的五金园艺连锁店；on special = 打折

items.ex: I grow herbs on my balcony — basil, mint and parsley.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国 h 要发音 /hɜːbz/，美国常读 /ɜːrbz/

items.ex: The flowers wilted in the heatwave.
items.tip: 比喻人「没精神」也能用：I'm wilting in this heat

items.ex: We feed our food scraps to the worm farm.
items.tip: 澳洲很多家庭用 worm farm / compost bin 处理厨余

items.ex: Koalas live in gum trees and eat the leaves.
items.tip: eucalyptus 的澳洲叫法；gumnut = 桉树果

items.ex: The cherry blossom is out in the Botanic Gardens.
items.tip: in full blossom = 盛开；jacaranda 紫花是悉尼春天标志

items.ex: The sunflowers are taller than me this year.
The tulip festival in Bowral is on in spring.
Prune the roses in winter for better flowers.
items.tip: prune 作名词是「西梅干」

items.ex: There's a bird's nest in our lemon tree.
We put white pebbles around the pot plants.
items.tip: 大石头叫 rock / boulder

items.ex: The café has a little water feature in the courtyard.
items.tip: fountain 也可以；courtyard = 庭院

items.ex: Melbourne's trams are free in the CBD.
items.tip: 墨尔本市中心电车免费区叫 Free Tram Zone；美国叫 streetcar

items.ex: I catch the ferry from Manly to Circular Quay every day.
items.tip: 坐交通工具用动词 catch：catch the bus/train/ferry

items.ex: He loaded the couch into the back of his ute.
items.tip: utility vehicle 的澳洲简称，美国叫 pickup truck

items.ex: I'll just grab a rideshare home after dinner.
items.tip: 澳洲口语直接说 grab an Uber；出租车叫 taxi / cab

items.ex: My commute is about 45 minutes by train.
items.tip: commuter = 通勤族

items.ex: The plane took off half an hour late.
items.tip: take off 还有「（事业）腾飞、突然火起来」的意思

items.ex: Text me when you land in Sydney.
items.tip: 「落地了给我发消息」超常用

items.ex: I only took a carry-on, so no checked bags.
items.tip: 托运行李 = checked luggage

items.ex: It took an hour to get through customs.
items.tip: 澳洲入境对食品检查很严：declare = 申报

items.ex: He rides his motorbike to work to avoid traffic.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 motorbike，美国说 motorcycle

items.ex: Pull over when you hear a siren behind you.
items.tip: pull over = 靠边停车

items.ex: Can you give me directions to the station?
items.tip: 问路：How do I get to…? / Could you give me directions?

items.ex: My parents are flying in for my graduation.
items.tip: graduate 动词读 /ˈɡrædʒueɪt/，名词「毕业生」读 /ˈɡrædʒuət/

items.ex: I bought a second-hand textbook to save money.
items.tip: second-hand = 二手的

items.ex: Don't forget to pack your hat in your schoolbag.
items.tip: 澳洲学校 No hat, no play（不戴帽子不能在户外玩）

items.ex: My lecturer posted the slides on Moodle.
items.tip: 大课叫 lecture，小组讨论课叫 tutorial（口语 tute）

items.ex: She's an undergrad studying commerce at Monash.
items.tip: 研究生 postgrad；澳洲本科 commerce = 商科

items.ex: You'll need a ruler and a set square for the maths exam.
items.tip: 澳洲说 maths（有 s），美国说 math

items.ex: We've got a chemistry lab on Thursday afternoon.
items.tip: laboratory 的简称；读音 /læb/

items.ex: The science experiment didn't go to plan.
He got full marks on the spelling test.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 marks，美国说 grades / score

items.zh: （澳洲大学）最高等级成绩 HD
items.ex: She got a high distinction for her marketing assignment.
items.tip: 澳洲大学成绩：HD > D > Credit > Pass > Fail

items.ex: Slow down — it's a 40 km/h school zone.
items.tip: 上下学时段超速会被重罚

items.ex: I bring a packed lunch to save money.
items.tip: 澳洲小学上午小休叫 recess，午餐叫 lunch；也可以说 bring lunch from home

items.ex: Slice up a red capsicum for the stir-fry.
items.tip: 澳洲说 capsicum，美国说 bell pepper

items.ex: Rockmelon is cheap in summer.
items.tip: 澳洲说 rockmelon，美国说 cantaloupe

items.ex: Throw a few spuds in the oven for dinner.
items.tip: potato 的口语说法

items.ex: Go easy on the chilli — I can't handle spicy food.
items.tip: 澳洲拼 chilli，美国拼 chili；go easy on = 少放点

items.ex: Crush two cloves of garlic for the sauce.
items.tip: 一整头蒜叫 a bulb of garlic；crush = 拍碎

items.ex: Add a thumb of fresh ginger to the soup.
items.tip: a thumb of ginger = 拇指大小的一块姜；ginger 也指红头发的人

items.ex: Woolies sells baby bok choy in bunches.
items.tip: Woolies = Woolworths 的昵称；澳洲超市常见亚洲蔬菜

items.ex: We grilled corn on the cob on the barbie.
Kiwifruit is packed with vitamin C.
items.tip: Kiwi 单独说时多指新西兰人

items.ex: Nothing says Aussie summer like a tray of mangoes.
items.tip: 澳洲人圣诞前后买一整箱 mango

items.ex: Toss some snow peas into the noodles.
items.tip: 澳洲说 snow peas，英国说 mangetout

items.ex: Dice a brown onion and fry it in olive oil.
items.tip: 澳洲菜谱常写 brown onion / red onion；dice = 切丁

items.ex: I had a quick power nap in my lunch break.
items.tip: nap = 打盹；doze off = 不小心睡着

items.ex: I cried my eyes out at the end of that movie.
items.tip: 也可以说 bawl my eyes out

items.ex: I was mind-blown when I saw the final numbers.
items.tip: 口语：That blew my mind!

items.ex: The kids gave me puppy-dog eyes until I bought ice cream.
He smirked when he heard he'd won the bet.
items.tip: smile 是正常笑，smirk 带点得意或嘲讽

items.zh: 无动于衷的、不以为然的
items.ex: The boss looked pretty unimpressed with the first draft.
I was totally starstruck when I met Kylie.
Don't freak out, but I think I deleted the file.
items.tip: 口语超常用；名词 freak-out

items.ex: The whole room gasped when she announced she was leaving.
I couldn't watch the scary bit, so I peeked through my fingers.
items.tip: sneak peek = 抢先看（营销常用）

items.ex: Don't worry about the surprise party — my lips are sealed.
items.tip: 也可以说 I won't tell a soul / zip it

items.ex: Don't look so innocent — I know you ate the last Tim Tam!
items.tip: Tim Tam = 澳洲国民巧克力饼干

items.ex: We had a barbie in the backyard on Saturday.
items.tip: 澳洲经典：一个带后院的独立屋 the great Australian dream

items.ex: Which suburb do you live in?
items.tip: 澳洲 suburb 指城市里的每个区，不一定是郊外；口语 burbs

items.ex: There were 40 people at the rental inspection on Saturday.
items.tip: open for inspection = 开放看房；routine inspection = 房东定期检查

items.ex: We're moving house this weekend — wish us luck!
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 move house，美国说 move

items.ex: Book a removalist early — they're busy at the end of the month.
items.tip: 澳洲说 removalist，美国说 movers

items.ex: Our kitchen reno is finally finished.
items.tip: renovation 的澳洲简称；动词 renovate

items.ex: They bought a fixer-upper in the inner west.
items.tip: 买便宜旧房自己翻新

items.ex: We sign the lease on Monday and move in on Friday.
items.tip: lease = 租约；break the lease = 提前解约

items.ex: It's really hard to find a pet-friendly rental in Sydney.
I locked myself out and had to call a locksmith.
items.tip: locksmith = 开锁匠

items.ex: Can you turn the aircon down? It's freezing in here.
items.tip: air conditioning 的口语说法；turn up/down = 调高/调低

items.ex: They live in an old red-brick house.
items.tip: 澳洲房子常见 brick veneer（砖贴面）

items.ex: Put your wallet away — it's my shout.
items.tip: It's my shout = 我请；shout someone a drink = 请某人喝一杯

items.ex: I'll grab a schooner of pale ale, thanks.
items.tip: 悉尼常见杯型：middy（小）< schooner（中）< pint（大）

items.ex: It's a BYO restaurant, so bring a bottle of red.
items.tip: Bring Your Own 的缩写；有时收 corkage（开瓶费）

items.ex: A whisky on the rocks, please.
items.tip: 不加冰叫 neat / straight

items.ex: I'm driving, so I'll have a mocktail.
items.tip: mock（假的）+ cocktail

items.ex: Happy hour is from 4 to 6 — $8 cocktails.
It's polite to slurp your ramen in Japan.
Let's grab lunch at the sushi train.
items.tip: 澳洲说 sushi train，别处常叫 conveyor belt sushi

items.ex: I'll have a burger with the lot.
items.tip: 澳洲经典 burger with the lot：加蛋、培根、菠萝、甜菜根

items.ex: Can we get a bowl of hot chips for the table?
items.tip: 澳洲 chips 可以指薯条也可以指薯片，所以薯条常说 hot chips；美国叫 fries

items.ex: The kids wanted a soft serve from Maccas.
items.tip: Maccas = 麦当劳的澳洲叫法

items.ex: Cook the pasta until it's al dente.
items.tip: 意大利语，指煮到中间还有一点硬

items.ex: It's only a light drizzle — you won't need a brolly.
It's bucketing down outside — wait till it eases.
items.tip: 也可以说 pouring / it's raining cats and dogs

items.ex: Tomorrow will be partly cloudy with a top of 26.
items.tip: a top of 26 = 最高气温 26 度

items.ex: It's been grey and overcast all day.
The forecast for the weekend is fine and sunny.
items.tip: 澳洲天气预报常用 fine = 晴天

items.ex: Brisbane gets really humid in summer.
items.tip: 名词 humidity；It's so muggy! 也是闷热

items.ex: A cyclone is forecast to cross the Queensland coast.
items.tip: 澳洲叫 cyclone，美国叫 hurricane，东亚叫 typhoon

items.ex: Get out of the pool — there's lightning about.
items.tip: 注意拼写：lightning 没有 e（lightening 是变亮）

items.ex: It's going to be gusty this arvo, so tie down the umbrella.
items.tip: gust = 一阵强风

items.ex: Remember to slip slop slap before the beach.
items.tip: Slip on a shirt, slop on sunscreen, slap on a hat

items.ex: There are water restrictions, so no hosing the car.
items.tip: 澳洲干旱时常实行；hose = 用水管冲洗

items.ex: We're heading to the snow for the long weekend.
items.tip: 澳洲人说 go to the snow = 去雪山（滑雪）

items.ex: Hang on, let me put some lippie on before we go.
items.tip: lipstick 的澳洲口语

items.ex: He hasn't shaved all week — he's growing a beard.
items.tip: 澳洲 11 月流行 Movember（留胡子为男性健康筹款）

items.ex: I've got a barber appointment at lunchtime.
items.tip: 女士常去 hairdresser / salon

items.ex: I treated myself to a facial for my birthday.
items.tip: treat myself = 犒劳自己

items.ex: After the hike I had a long soak in the bath.
items.tip: soak up the sun = 晒太阳

items.ex: The gym has a sauna and steam room.
items.tip: 澳洲读 /ˈsɔːnə/

items.ex: Check your outfit in the full-length mirror.
items.tip: outfit = 一身穿搭

items.ex: I left my purse at home — can you shout me?
items.tip: 澳洲/英国 purse = 女士钱包；美国 purse = 手提包

items.ex: She carries a laptop in her handbag.
It's minus two in Canberra — bring your puffer jacket.
items.tip: 澳洲常说 puffer；美国也说 down jacket

items.ex: What's the dress code for the Christmas party?
items.tip: 请柬上常见：cocktail / black tie / smart casual

items.ex: The dress code is smart casual — no thongs, please.
items.tip: 比正装随意、比休闲正式

items.ex: We keep three chooks in the backyard for eggs.
items.tip: chicken 的澳洲叫法

items.ex: The cat purrs every time you scratch her chin.
All our rescue cats are desexed and microchipped.
items.tip: 澳洲说 desexed，美国说 spayed / neutered；microchipped = 植入芯片

items.ex: The dog left muddy paw prints all over the floor.
items.tip: paw prints = 爪印

items.ex: Please don't pat a guide dog while it's working.
items.tip: pat = 轻拍、抚摸（宠物）

items.ex: I take the dog to get groomed every six weeks.
items.tip: groomer = 宠物美容师；groom 也指「新郎」

items.ex: The new pup chewed through my shoe.
items.tip: puppy 的口语简称

items.ex: Clean the fish tank once a fortnight.
items.tip: fortnight = 两周（澳洲常用）

items.ex: Sea turtles nest on Queensland beaches.
items.tip: 陆龟一般叫 tortoise

items.ex: A brown snake slithered across the path.
items.tip: 澳洲夏天要小心 snakes

items.ex: Farmers shear their sheep before summer.
items.tip: shearing shed = 剪羊毛棚；shearer = 剪毛工

items.ex: My niece wants a hamster for Christmas.
items.tip: 注意读音 /ˈhæmstə/，不是「汉姆斯特」

items.ex: I binge-watched the whole season over the weekend.
items.tip: binge = 放纵地大量做某事

items.ex: We've got tickets to a gig at the Enmore on Friday.
items.tip: 口语 gig = live music show；也指临时工作 gig economy

items.ex: We did a 1,000-piece jigsaw over Christmas.
items.tip: jigsaw puzzle 的简称

items.ex: Let's have a board game night on Saturday.
Checkmate! You owe me a coffee.
items.tip: chess = 国际象棋

items.ex: He spends most weekends gaming with his mates.
items.tip: mates = 朋友（澳洲）

items.ex: He was strumming his guitar on the balcony.
She snapped a quick photo of the sunset.
items.tip: 口语：Take a snap / Let me snap a pic

items.ex: My grandma knitted me a beanie.
items.tip: k 不发音；beanie = 毛线帽

items.ex: Can you sew this button back on for me?
items.tip: 读音 /səʊ/ 和 so 一样，不是 /suː/

items.ex: I've signed up for a Tuesday night art class.
items.tip: sign up for = 报名

items.ex: Our book club meets once a month at the local café.
Sorry, I have to hang up — my train's here.
items.tip: hang up on someone = 挂某人电话（不礼貌）

items.ex: Can I call you back in five minutes?
items.tip: 澳洲也常说 ring you back

items.ex: I always look up new words in my dictionary app.
items.tip: look up to someone = 敬佩某人

items.ex: Let me jot down your number.
items.tip: 比 write down 更随意、更快

items.ex: I can't figure out how to use this new software.
items.tip: work out 意思接近（澳洲常用）

items.ex: We're running out of time — let's skip to the last slide.
items.tip: run out of + 名词

items.ex: Let's wrap up the meeting — it's nearly five.
items.tip: 职场常用；wrap up warm = 穿暖和点

items.ex: The new campaign launches on Monday.
items.tip: 营销高频词；launch event = 发布会

items.ex: Can you chuck out the old milk? It's gone off.
items.tip: gone off = 变质了（澳洲口语）

items.ex: I switch off my notifications after 7pm.
items.tip: 也指「放下工作、脑子放空」

items.ex: We'll send out the invites next week.
Hold on a sec, I'll grab a pen.
items.tip: 电话里常说 Hold on / Hang on

items.ex: I'll do click and collect so I don't pay for delivery.
items.tip: 澳洲超市和商场很常见

items.ex: Lots of young shoppers use buy now pay later at checkout.
items.tip: 缩写 BNPL；澳洲常见品牌 Afterpay

items.ex: There's a 24-hour flash sale on sneakers.
Orders over $50 get free shipping.
items.tip: 澳洲也说 free delivery / free postage

items.ex: You can return it within 30 days for a full refund.
items.tip: refund = 退款；exchange = 换货

items.ex: The product has hundreds of five-star reviews.
I'll add it to my wishlist and wait for a sale.
I sorted out the refund through live chat.
items.tip: sort out = 搞定

items.ex: Taobao gives out digital red packets during the sale.
items.tip: 也叫 red envelope / hongbao

items.ex: The parcel was too big for the letterbox.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 letterbox，美国说 mailbox

items.ex: Is it brand new or second-hand?
items.tip: 二手 = second-hand / pre-loved（营销常用）

items.ex: I'll post the package tomorrow morning.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国说 post，美国说 mail；Australia Post = 澳洲邮政

items.ex: Most of our new customers come through word of mouth.
items.tip: WOM marketing = 口碑营销

items.ex: The teaser created a lot of buzz before launch.
items.tip: generate / create buzz = 制造话题

items.ex: The finals get millions of eyeballs, so the ad slots are pricey.
items.tip: 营销口语 eyeballs = 观看人数、注意力

items.ex: We're shooting a 30-second TVC next month.
items.tip: TV commercial 的缩写，澳洲广告圈常用

items.ex: Send the press release to media under embargo.
items.tip: under embargo = 约定时间前不得发布

items.ex: Our billboard is right outside Central Station.
items.tip: 户外广告 = OOH (out-of-home)

items.ex: Use the campaign hashtag in every post.
The brand reposted our customer's video.
The product photo shoot is on Thursday at the studio.
We want our brand to be top of mind when people think of coffee.
items.tip: top-of-mind awareness = 第一提及率

items.ex: The company rebranded with a new logo and name.
We saw an uptick in sales after the campaign.
items.tip: 比 increase 更口语，常用于数据小幅增长

items.ex: G'day mate, how's it going?
items.tip: Good day 的连读；常接 mate

items.ex: Thanks for the help! — No worries.
items.tip: 澳洲万能回答：不客气 / 没关系 / 好的

items.ex: Do you reckon it'll rain this arvo?
items.tip: 澳洲口语常用，比 think 更随意

items.ex: Drinks after work? — Yeah, I'm keen!
items.tip: I'm keen = 我想去

items.ex: I'm so stoked we won the pitch!
I'm absolutely knackered after that week.
items.tip: 澳洲也说 buggered / stuffed

items.ex: See you Saturday arvo!
items.tip: afternoon 的澳洲简称

items.ex: Let's grab brekkie before work.
items.tip: breakfast 的澳洲口语

items.ex: I'll grab some wine from the bottle-o on the way.
items.tip: bottle shop 的澳洲口语

items.ex: Ta, I'll pay you back tomorrow.
items.tip: 澳洲/英国口语里很短的「谢谢」

items.ex: The train was chockers this morning.
items.tip: chock-a-block 的澳洲简称

items.ex: That website looks a bit dodgy — don't put your card details in.
